name: Extern create indexed/indexed, key none: retain values and addressing
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4template create extern_inst/scalarRules/Register/reg1 tc_numel 1 instid 1 control_path param left ptype bit32 id 2 default_value 11 param right ptype bit32 id 3 default_value 22
verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; $TC -j p4template get extern_inst/scalarRules/Register/reg1 >/tmp/p4tc-scalar-$TESTID.json; python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; value=json.load(sys.stdin); walk=lambda x: ([x] if isinstance(x,dict) else []) + [v for child in (x.values() if isinstance(x,dict) else x if isinstance(x,list) else []) for v in walk(child)]; items=[(p["name"],p["value"]) for p in walk(value) if p.get("name") in ("left","right") and "value" in p]; assert sorted(items)==[('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'left'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 11), ('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'right'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', 22)], (items,value)'"'"' </tmp/p4tc-scalar-$TESTID.json; printf consistent'
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/scalarRules 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf "%s\n" "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'

verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; python3 -c '"'"'import sys; assert open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines()[0] == "Error: All data parameters must be scalars."'"'"' /tmp/p4tc-scalar-$TESTID.err; if $TC -j p4template get extern_inst/scalarRules/Register/reg1; then exit 1; else test "$?" -eq 255; fi; $TC p4template del extern/root/Register; $TC p4template create extern/root/Register extid 1 numinstances 2; $TC p4template create extern_inst/scalarRules/Register/reg1 tc_numel 1 instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param left ptype bit32 id 2 default_value 11 param right ptype bit32 id 3 default_value 22; $TC p4template del extern_inst/scalarRules/Register/reg1; $TC p4template del extern/root/Register; $TC p4template create extern/root/Register extid 1 numinstances 2; printf consistent'
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/scalarRules 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf "%s\n" "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
